title: deschampsia media var. iberica
intro: Deschampsia media var. iberica, commonly known as Iberian hair grass, is a type of flowering plant in the grass family. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Deschampsia media var. iberica include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may help in soothing and protecting the skin and mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
